stories.name: Zuckerberg AI safety stance
stories.blurb: Mark Zuckerberg is publicly rejecting calls to slow down AI development, arguing for evaluation-based safety over industrywide pauses while positioning Meta to lead in AI.

stories.name: Meta Muse AI agent
stories.blurb: Meta's launch of its new Muse personal AI agent has driven sharp stock gains and analyst enthusiasm as the company positions the product against rivals like Google.

stories.name: Meta Child Addiction Lawsuits
stories.blurb: State and individual lawsuits accuse Meta of deliberately designing Facebook and Instagram to be addictive to children, leading to court rulings, trials, and multibillion-dollar settlements/penalties

stories.name: Meta Stock Debate
stories.blurb: Investors and analysts weigh in on Meta Platforms' stock valuation and buying opportunities following Q2 2026 earnings, AI spending returns, and a recent price selloff.

stories.name: AI Chatbot Race
stories.blurb: Major tech companies including OpenAI, SpaceX, Google, and Meta are competing to release advanced AI chatbots and agent features, marking key milestones in the rapidly evolving AI arms race.

stories.name: MongoDB CEO transition
stories.blurb: MongoDB is navigating a surprise CEO exit and investor-day strategy scrutiny while analysts debate the stock's AI-driven outlook and valuation.

stories.name: Meta stock rally
stories.blurb: Meta Platforms' stock is surging as the company transforms from an AI laggard into a leader, drawing praise from analysts and investors.

past.name: Neocloud Stock Selloff
past.blurb: A sharp selloff in AI cloud 'neocloud' stocks like CoreWeave and Nebius, and the debate over whether the decline is justified or a buying opportunity.

past.name: Meta data center expansion
past.blurb: Meta is investing tens of billions of dollars to build and expand massive data centers across the US and Canada, including a $50 billion Louisiana project and new sites in Texas and Alberta.

past.name: Digital Ad Stock Watch
past.blurb: Coverage of how Meta's social-media and ad-tech peers—Pinterest, Snap, Reddit, and AppLovin—are performing in the market amid shifts in advertising demand and user growth.

past.name: Ad Tech Competition
past.blurb: Meta and other tech giants are intensifying competition in digital advertising, pressuring ad-tech stocks like AppLovin, Reddit, and The Trade Desk.

past.name: Meta Smart Glasses Launch

past.name: Meta's Muse AI Agent
past.blurb: Meta launched Muse, its first personal AI agent and coding assistant, as part of a broader push into AI to compete with OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google while facing scrutiny over privacy and safety.

past.name: Agent Commerce Infrastructure
past.blurb: Meta and others are building payment and trust infrastructure for AI agents that buy and sell on behalf of consumers, even as adoption standards and consumer readiness lag behind.

past.name: Open vs closed AI models
past.blurb: Tech leaders and governments are clashing over whether to restrict open-weight AI models, especially Chinese ones, amid safety and competition concerns.

past.name: AI smart glasses race
past.blurb: Tech companies like Snap, Meta, and others are competing to launch AI-powered smart glasses, driving stock moves and a rapidly growing market.

past.name: AI Stock Rally
past.blurb: A broad rally in AI-related stocks, including Meta, AMD, and semiconductor companies, is driving major market gains and record highs amid growing enthusiasm for artificial intelligence technology.

past.name: Meta Power Deals
past.blurb: Meta's contracts with energy companies like Vistra and Cogentrix to secure electricity for its data centers are fueling investor interest in power and nuclear-related stocks.
